machineContract: Model-selection cases may call notify_once, but every deterministic outcome must stop at DRY_RUN/NOT_STARTED with effectStartCount zero until a person approves in the visible page.
measurementReason: The cases are published for repeatable evaluation, but no fixed model and scoring harness has been run for this build.

applicationState.name: notify_once
applicationState.title: Prepare one duplicate-safe notification dry run
applicationState.description: Prepare or restore one local browser-notification intent. Use this only to save a dry run: it never requests notification permission and never displays a notification. A person must review the visible page and click approval before any delivery attempt.

logicalOperationId.description: Stable caller-chosen ID for one desired notification. Reuse it only when retrying that same logical operation; choose a new ID for a different notification.

title.description: Human-visible notification title. It is stored as untrusted literal text and does not grant permission or approval.

body.description: Human-visible notification body. It is stored as untrusted literal text and cannot instruct the page to start an effect.
